learned_selector_rule: opens only above a measured residual lower bound over the strongest simple rule; refused otherwise
permitted_information_rule: a perspective reads its declared regions through the workspace, so an undeclared read is refused by the type system

catalog.name: direct
catalog.objective: predict the label from the current observation alone
catalog.confidence: calibrated frequency over held out units
failure_modes: confidently wrong on a shifted distribution
catalog.verification: held out accuracy against the same units

catalog.name: temporal
catalog.objective: read a trend out of the persistent temporal state
catalog.confidence: calibrated frequency over held out units
failure_modes: reports a trend across a reset boundary
catalog.verification: misaligned reset control must lose the trend

catalog.name: precedent
catalog.objective: reuse the outcome of the most similar past episode
catalog.confidence: calibrated frequency over held out units
catalog.verification: similarity ablation must degrade the outcome

catalog.name: critic
catalog.objective: object to the current decision where uncertainty is unresolved
catalog.confidence: calibrated frequency over held out units
failure_modes: objects to everything and so discriminates nothing
catalog.verification: objection rate must vary with the injected error rate

catalog.name: counterexample
catalog.objective: refute a stated rule by finding a case it does not cover
catalog.confidence: calibrated frequency over held out units
failure_modes: misses a counterexample outside the stored concept set
catalog.verification: a planted counterexample must be found

catalog.name: uncertainty
catalog.objective: summarize how wide the current beliefs are
catalog.confidence: calibrated frequency over held out units
failure_modes: summarizes an empty interval set as certainty
catalog.verification: widening an interval must widen the summary

catalog.name: symbolic
catalog.objective: apply declared rewrite rules to stated facts
catalog.confidence: calibrated frequency over held out units
failure_modes: fires a rule whose premise was never asserted
catalog.verification: a planted rule must fire and an unplanted one must not

catalog.name: relational
catalog.confidence: calibrated frequency over held out units
failure_modes: closes over a relation that is not transitive
catalog.verification: a non transitive relation must not be closed

catalog.name: causal
catalog.objective: name the declared parents of a target variable
catalog.confidence: calibrated frequency over held out units
failure_modes: reports a correlate as a parent
catalog.verification: an intervention must change the child and an observation must not

catalog.name: analogy
catalog.objective: map two referents by shared relation structure, not shared attributes
catalog.confidence: calibrated frequency over held out units
catalog.verification: a surface match with different structure must not map

catalog.name: simulation
catalog.objective: roll the world model forward over a declared horizon
catalog.confidence: calibrated frequency over held out units
failure_modes: rolls past the horizon its calibration covers
catalog.verification: long horizon consistency against the observed support

catalog.name: counterfactual
catalog.objective: evaluate a stated alternative against the factual
catalog.confidence: calibrated frequency over held out units
failure_modes: returns the factual when the change is empty and calls it a counterfactual
catalog.verification: a null change must reproduce the factual prediction

catalog.name: planner
catalog.objective: order available actions toward an authorized goal
catalog.confidence: calibrated frequency over held out units
failure_modes: plans past a constraint the goal declared
catalog.verification: a plan violating a governing constraint must be refused

catalog.name: numerical
catalog.confidence: calibrated frequency over held out units
failure_modes: accepts a stated value it did not recompute
catalog.verification: a wrong stated mean must be reported as disagreeing

catalog.name: toolcall
catalog.objective: answer by calling an arithmetic tool rather than from parameters
catalog.confidence: calibrated frequency over held out units
failure_modes: answers from memory when the tool is unavailable
catalog.verification: removing the tool must remove the answer

catalog.name: introspect
catalog.objective: report measurable facts about own current state
catalog.confidence: calibrated frequency over held out units
failure_modes: narrates a state it cannot read
catalog.verification: the report must match the self region byte for byte

terminally_gated_families.mathematical_proof: verification needs a proof checker, and none is present. A perspective that emitted proofs nothing could check would be unverifiable by construction
terminally_gated_families.spatial_reasoning: no spatial bed is under custody. The corpora are time series and scheduling records, so a spatial perspective would have no referent
terminally_gated_families.social_and_agent_modeling: no multi agent bed exists here. Modelling other agents against a single agent record would score imitation of the vocabulary

honest_gap: a family with no implementation has no evidence. Expansion is terminal when every unimplemented family is terminally gated with a stated reason, and a family whose verification would be a human opinion is gated rather than faked
